name: social-earnings-studio
description: Professional AI Video Creation, Phone Control & Social Publishing Desktop App
author: Social Earnings Studio Team

scripts.build: npm run build:vite && npm run build:electron
scripts.build:electron: tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.mkdirSync('dist-electron/main/database/migrations', {recursive:true}); fs.readdirSync('src/main/database/migrations').forEach(f => { if(f.endsWith('.sql')) fs.copyFileSync('src/main/database/migrations/' + f, 'dist-electron/main/database/migrations/' + f); });"
